title: Node telemetry record, version 1
description: One record per node per simulation tick (Project Brief §10.1). Owner: Parikshit. Read by the router (Krupesh), the feasibility filter (Jyotir) and the context vector (Sur). A minor version (1.x) may only add optional fields; renaming or removing a field needs version 2 and a message to the whole group.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. The router rejects other major versions.

t.description: Simulation time of the snapshot, in seconds since the start of the run.

node_id.description: Unique node name, for example us-east-nyc.

status.description: up: serving normally. down: unreachable, takes no requests. warming: back after an outage and serving, but slower until its warm-up ends.

rtt_ms.description: Round-trip network delay from each user region to this node, in milliseconds.

queue_len.description: Requests waiting at the node for a free slot (not yet started).

running.description: Requests being served now (prefill or decode). Never more than capacity.

capacity.description: Maximum number of requests the node serves at the same time.

kv_used_frac.description: Share of the node's KV-cache memory in use, from 0 (empty) to 1 (full).

models_loaded.description: Models the node can serve, for example ["llama-3-8b"].

power_headroom_kw.description: Power the node could still draw before reaching its site limit, in kW. 0 when the node is down.

energy_price_usd_kwh.description: Electricity price at the node's site now, in US dollars per kWh.

gpu_price_usd_hr.description: Rent of one of the node's GPUs, in US dollars per hour.

kv_capacity_tokens.description: Optional (v1.0 extension): the node's KV-cache size in tokens, so the filter can check whether a request's input + output tokens still fit. null if unknown.
